Conversion of FS Water Tank (消防水缸) into fresh water tank (食水缸)  
70. For the purposes of this hearing, I have learnt from the bundles provided to me, in particular the minutes of the meeting of the Incorporated Owners of Wang Fuk Court (Bundle H1-3 ISS EPP (6033-6036, 6076-6078 & 6113-6115)), that the Incorporated Owners and PC&E decided to first repair the FS Water Tanks and thereafter convert them into temporary fresh water tanks.

71. I further understand that the repair works on the FS Water Tanks in Block G Wang Shing House (宏盛閣) and Block H Wang Chi House (宏志閣) had been completed by 30 August 2025 (Bundle H1-3 ISS EPP (6113-6115)).

72. I was not aware of these matters at the material time. Mr Cheung did not inform me of this, notwithstanding that he had agreed to notify me upon completion of the repair works on the FS Water Tanks.

Repair Works to FS Water Tanks  
73. I trusted that PC&E would either carry out the repair works itself or engage another contractor to do so under their supervision. I did not inquire into the details. I have recently learned, from the bundle provided to me for the purposes of this hearing, in particular the witness statement of Mr Wu Rizhao, a worker from Red Sun Construct (Asia) Engineering Limited (太陽建設亞洲有限公司) (Bundle C1-2 Police (1189–1192)), and the witness statement of Mr Lui Sze Lung, a worker from Tin Hung Engineering Co. (天雄工程) (Bundle C1-2 Police (1178-1183))that:
